facets.title: インスティンクトモデル

facts.text: インスティンクトは小さな学習済み行動です：
アトミック - 1つのトリガー、1つのアクション
信頼度重み付け - 0.3 = 暫定的、0.9 = ほぼ確実
ドメインタグ付き - code-style、testing、git、debugging、workflowなど
証拠に基づく - それを作成した観察を追跡
~/.claude/settings.jsonに追加します。
プラグインとしてインストールした場合（推奨）：

{ "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "~/.claude/skills/continuous-learning-v2/hooks/observe.sh" }] }], "PostToolUse": [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "~/.claude/skills/continuous-learning-v2/hooks/observe.sh" }] }] } }
mkdir -p ~/.claude/homunculus/{instincts/{personal,inherited},evolved/{agents,skills,commands}} touch ~/.claude/homunculus/observations.jsonl
/instinct-status     # 信頼度スコア付きの学習済みインスティンクトを表示 /evolve              # 関連するインスティンクトをスキル/コマンドにクラスター化 /instinct-export     # 共有のためにインスティンクトをエクスポート /instinct-import     # 他の人からインスティンクトをインポート

{ "version": "2.0", "observation": { "enabled": true, "store_path": "~/.claude/homunculus/observations.jsonl", "max_file_size_mb": 10, "archive_after_days": 7 }, "instincts": { "personal_path": "~/.claude/homunculus/instincts/personal/", "inherited_path": "~/.claude/homunculus/instincts/inherited/", "min_confidence": 0.3, "auto_approve_threshold": 0.7, "confidence_decay_rate": 0.05 }, "observer": { "enabled": true, "model": "haiku", "run_interval_minutes": 5, "patterns_to_detect": [ "user_corrections", "error_resolutions", "repeated_workflows", "tool_preferences" ] }, "evolution": { "cluster_threshold": 3, "evolved_path": "~/.claude/homunculus/evolved/" } }

~/.claude/homunculus/ ├── identity.json           # プロフィール、技術レベル ├── observations.jsonl      # 現在のセッション観察 ├── observations.archive/   # 処理済み観察 ├── instincts/ │   ├── personal/           # 自動学習されたインスティンクト │   └── inherited/          # 他の人からインポート └── evolved/ ├── agents/             # 生成された専門エージェント ├── skills/             # 生成されたスキル └── commands/           # 生成されたコマンド

Claude Code setups that repeat the same corrections across many sessions — a preferred git workflow, a recurring tool preference, a repeated debugging pattern — and would benefit from those corrections being captured automatically.

facts.text: Teams wanting to share learned behaviors across people or machines, since instincts can be exported and imported rather than staying locked to one person's session history.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Situations where low-confidence, still-forming behavioral patterns should accumulate evidence over multiple observations before being trusted, rather than acting on a single occurrence.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Growing a set of related, individually small instincts into a proper reusable skill, agent, or command once enough of them cluster around the same workflow.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Enable the PreToolUse/PostToolUse observation hooks in settings.json and let the system accumulate observations for a week of normal work before reviewing what instincts it proposed via /instinct-status.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Tune the confidence-decay rate and auto-approve threshold to match your risk tolerance — a stricter auto-approve threshold trades slower automation for fewer false-positive learned behaviors.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Use /evolve to promote a cluster of related instincts sharing a domain tag into a generated skill, agent, or command, then review the generated artifact before trusting it in production.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Export your personal instincts with /instinct-export and import a colleague's with /instinct-import to bootstrap a shared team baseline instead of starting from zero on a new machine.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Enabling the observation hooks without ever reviewing /instinct-status, letting low-confidence or wrong instincts accumulate unchecked instead of being pruned or corrected.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Setting the auto-approve threshold too low, letting the system act on instincts that are still statistically thin (few supporting observations) as if they were well-established.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Importing another person's or team's instincts wholesale without reviewing them for relevance, since a workflow preference tuned to one codebase or role can actively mislead in a different context.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Treating an evolved skill or command generated from clustered instincts as finished the moment it's created, instead of reviewing it the way you would any other newly authored skill.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Instincts are atomic by design (one trigger, one action), so a genuinely conditional or multi-step behavior may not be representable as a single instinct without decomposition.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Confidence scores are derived from the observations that produced them, so a system in early use with few observations will have systematically lower-confidence instincts regardless of how correct the underlying behavior is.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: The observer component runs on a lightweight model on a fixed interval, which trades observation cost against how quickly a new pattern is detected and turned into a candidate instinct.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.

facts.text: Because instincts and observations are stored locally under ~/.claude/homunculus/, moving to a new machine without an explicit export/import step means the accumulated learning does not automatically follow you.
facts.note: AI-suggested, synthesized from this pack's existing facts — not extracted from a source document.
